name: standing-external-rotation-no-money
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position with the elbows bent to 90 degrees and holding a band with a supinated (palms up) grip.
2. Inhale and allow the hands to travel laterally by externally rotating at the shoulder while keeping the elbows tight to your torso.
3. Slowly lower the band back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
